name: BACH_0261
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (86%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set and second-model agreement support Benign [F1]; all five similar cases are Normal.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 86%, Normal 14% | Clear leader |
| Conformal set | Benign only (90%) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.975 / 8th percentile | Typical, good quality |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 0/5 match | All five Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 7, 10) · ↓ invasive · Largest negative term in concept model [F2] · Unreliable (0/20)
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 3, 7, 11) · ↑ invasive · Concept model links it to invasive carcinoma [F3] · Validated (19/20)
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 4, 6, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; linked to lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Weak (18/20)
- **Nuclei sample** (regions 3, 7, 11) · context · Neoplastic nuclei 3, 1, 0 per region; insufficient tumor nuclei flagged · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect classifier use. Normal lobules is Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- All five similar cases are Normal; the Benign vs Normal call may be off.
- Stroma scores are high in regions 3, 7, 11, but sampled nuclei show few tumor cells.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 7, 11:** Confirm whether stroma is tumor-infiltrated or benign fibrous stroma.
2. **Regions 3, 7, 10:** Verify normal lobules directly; this concept failed its spot check.
3. **Regions 4, 6, 8:** Check that glandular architecture is benign, not tubule-forming carcinoma.
